steps.instruction: Confirm the holder is locked, orientation is correct, the course is clear and the applicable setup checks are complete.
Start recording. Let the RC settle, then keep it untouched for about five quiet seconds.
Start forward gradually and follow the marked lane. Release the lever to neutral at B and allow the RC to stop before C. Do not apply the opposite lever for this exercise.
Once the RC has stopped and its body has settled, keep it untouched for about five quiet seconds.
Stop recording and save the original immediately.
Confirm what actually happened and select any unusual observations. Uncertain answers are allowed.
Explicitly upload when connected. Keep the phone original after server verification.
